vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 Senate votes, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 14. Nay or No: 25. Not Voting: 1. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
Last year, Trump forced through the largest SNAP cut in history. Now, he wants to make it harder for another 6.3 MILLION people to put food on the table.
 
We need to start working to reverse this harm on day one and put working people first — not Trump’s billionaire buddies.

In this election Americans were clear. In addition to rejecting Trump’s policies, they want us to:
-End the Iran war
-Unrig our economy
-Stop trying to engineer elections from DC
-Give new voices a chance to lead
 To answer that call & earn their trust, we need new leadership. https://t.co/1qB18BumwX

In this election, Americans called on us to unrig an economy rigged against working people & fueled by political corruption.

To deliver, we need new leadership. This isn't about any one person – it’s about answering that call.

That's why I’m running for Senate Majority Leader.

On Veterans Day and every day we’re grateful to our those who have raised their hand to protect our freedom & democracy.
 
We must never lose sight of our responsibility to turn that gratitude into action to deliver & improve the support & care our veterans have earned.

Maria Flores Garcia was her high school’s valedictorian & is a student at UMD. Her arrest is the latest example of how Trump lied when he said that he’d only go after the “worst of the worst.”
 
I’m seeking answers on Maria’s detention & working to get her released.

https://t.co/3fh4giesqU
Send Pete packing. https://t.co/zFf3VOlOFR
Read the letter here: https://t.co/cOX1jPmhy9

Today, I led 11 of my Senate colleagues in calling on House & Senate leadership to strip the upcoming defense bill of provisions that MANDATE defense & intelligence cooperation with Israel — including one advanced by Netanyahu himself.
 
This doesn’t make us safer, see why ⬇️ https://t.co/hpaP3Vh6L5

While people across the country could barely make ends meet, Trump made $1.4 BILLION from his crypto schemes alone last year.
 
This is exactly the type of corruption we’ve got to tackle head on. Americans deserve answers on his White House money-making schemes. https://t.co/YRG4KGpf1Z

The American people have spoken loud & clear: They want us to end Trump’s illegal & senseless war.

And in 1 month, we’ll have an opportunity to do that.

I will not support a government funding bill unless it defunds this war. https://t.co/FEcBvsPfG9

There it is. Just as we predicted, Trump is now trying to sow doubt in our elections.

Last week, millions of Americans rejected Trump’s illegal war, high prices, cruelty, and corruption. Now he wants to silence them.

We won’t let him. https://t.co/oC0KSbsg77

Buckle up: this is a sign of Trump's contempt for the voters.

In the aftermath of an election that was a repudiation of Trump's corruption, wars, cruelty, and indifference to the economic pain of Americans, it’s another kick in the teeth to the American people. https://t.co/u626J2Gsp6

Trump and Netanyahu started this senseless war. 

Republicans in Congress supported it. 

But we’re sure as hell going to end it. https://t.co/SIHUre5ijD

It’s a new day in American politics.

This victory belongs to the American people – to the patriots who never lost faith in our country.

Time to get to work! https://t.co/uw48pOM2KG

Today’s the day! 
 
Get out there and make your voice heard, America.
 
GO VOTE!

This is the right decision by SCOTUS to protect the integrity of our elections against Trump's baseless efforts to rig them.

As Trump's authoritarian govt continues to attack our free & fair elections, we must keep standing up in Congress, in the courts, and in our communities. https://t.co/Z2LmEVbP8x

Musk's pouring millions into our elections while he rakes in $16 BILLION in taxpayer-funded contracts. A fat return.
 
We need to pass my bill w/ @RepRobertGarcia to close the loophole that lets CEOs grab govt contracts with one hand while forking over campaign $ with the other. https://t.co/8hPUQ7VAKk

Since Trump started this illegal & senseless war in Iran, his buddies in Big Oil have made $130 BILLION in profit while American households have paid over $1,100 in extra fuel costs.
 
Literally profiting off working people's pain.
 
To save lives & lower costs, this war must end.

https://t.co/DyhOcrcJ63

DoorDash spent years stiffing workers but just coughed up $17 BILLION to buy a competitor.
 
If you can cut a check for $17 BILLION, you can afford to pay your workers a fair & living wage.
 
Meanwhile, Trump's FTC is silent as more & more mergers raise prices & hurt workers. https://t.co/LfRyfBgJyD

Trump is still trying to use your tax dollars to run his propaganda ads on TV, in yet another attempt to illegally influence the midterms for Trump.
 
YOUR tax dollars should be used to lower YOUR costs, improve YOUR schools, or fix YOUR roads — not to run ads for the president. https://t.co/5K6T06skhL

When Trump says, "We're making a freaking fortune," he doesn't mean you or working Americans, he means his billionaire buddies in Big Oil who financed his campaign.
 
Remember: Trump's planning to re-intensify the war in a few days. He doesn't give a damn how it hurts Americans. https://t.co/jjm29B5UNk

Billionaires like Elon Musk are spending gobs of money to elect candidates who can then turn around & funnel your taxpayer dollars to those same billionaires’ companies.

@RepRobertGarcia & I have a bill to close this corrupt campaign cash-for-contracts loophole. https://t.co/hee4EpKAB4

.@RepYassAnsari is right. Patriotism has nothing to do with your name, race, or religion, it's about standing up for our Constitution.

Trump uses these bigoted, un-American attacks to try & get working people to turn on each other so they don't blame him for his failed policies. https://t.co/HJPh6k6Kui

🚨 They're STILL covering up the Epstein Files. Blanche specifically said there was no classified material in the Epstein Files — was that a lie? What are they hiding?
 
This coverup is illegal & needs to end now.

https://t.co/T7ysTPPNfN

Michael & Susan Pretti saw their son gunned down by DHS officers & watched this admin smear him as a "domestic terrorist." Now they can't get answers about his death from Trump, Blanche, & Mullin. 

Everyone engaged in this cover up must be held accountable.

https://t.co/Oiy3J4WX54

Yesterday, after weeks of escalating crackdowns, Egypt’s govt shut down Mada Masr, one of the country’s leading independent outlets, & convicted its editor-in-chief, Lina Attalah.
 
They must reverse this decision & stop their assault on press freedoms.
 
Journalism is not a crime.

Yesterday, after weeks of escalating crackdowns, Egypt’s govt shut down Mada Masr, one of the country’s leading independent outlets, & arrested its editor-in-chief, Lina Attalah.

They must reverse this decision & release Lina immediately.

Journalism is not a crime. https://t.co/5k5FvLit9K

Daylight robbery. A billion-dollar corporation — that's making record profits for its executives & doing billions in stock buybacks — should not be paying less in taxes than any working American.  We need to reshape our tax code FOR working people. https://t.co/DsH7hZvtWJ

Trump & Republicans would rather make you ration your meds & skip a doctor’s appointment than make a billionaire pay their fair share.
 
In the richest country in the world, healthcare shouldn't be a privilege for the rich, it should be a right for all.
 
We need Medicare for All.
America must put an end to this gross abuse of power. Blanche must be held accountable for this blatant prosecutorial misconduct & complicit DOJ officials held in contempt. https://t.co/fyQnkuwUUX

Israeli settlers & forces are driving even more Palestinians from their homes on the West Bank.

The U.S. must end its complicity in the injustice of the occupation and demand accountability for the 9 Americans killed.

Enough is enough. https://t.co/MzWPcekcbb

Working Americans around the country are having to choose between getting groceries or filling up a tank of gas — all thanks to Trump.

But what is he focused on? Finding new schemes to evade taxes on his billions. Despicable. https://t.co/xDTsuZnV4P

Trump’s illegal Iran war is turning into our next forever war.
 
8 months in, Trump & Republicans have deluded themselves into thinking the next strike or another bombing campaign will finally bring victory.
 
From Vietnam to Iraq, we know how this ends.
 
This war must end NOW. https://t.co/2luu3tYRip

The cover-up continues. First they lied about what we could see with our own eyes & called Alex Pretti & Renee Good ‘domestic terrorists.’ Now they’re back to hiding evidence from MN state investigators.

MN investigators must be given access to ALL evidence. This impunity must

If you’re concerned about new power generation, let’s talk offshore wind. Maryland's project could power 600,000+ homes, but it's being held up by the Admin.

So Commissioner, will you call on them to stop blocking this new power generation or do you only support fossil fuels? https://t.co/ZWr8ZUp0rq

Less than a month after arresting the entire Matsadaash newsroom, the Egyptian govt has now filed baseless charges against the editor-in-chief of Mada Masr, continuing their largest crackdown in years.
 
This assault on the free press must end NOW. Journalism is not a crime. https://t.co/PeJvNcZdhk

Why is GM nickel and diming their workers if they have billions for stock buybacks?
 
These profits belong, first & foremost, to the workers who created them. Sending them to Wall Street & their executives is gross abuse of corporate power. Give it back! https://t.co/PpdxKd79NO

Since last Saturday, Meta executives have given vague & shifting answers for why the No Kings Instagram was taken down at the height of the protests.
 
Today, I'm calling on Meta to come clean.
 
Is Meta intentionally censoring speech? Americans deserve answers. https://t.co/XgrS9Wwd8q https://t.co/f6qZdz9lCC

Vladimir Putin is a war criminal. He's responsible for killing over 150,000 Ukrainians — including more than 15,000 civilians — and the murder of political opponents & dissidents.
 
Witkoff & Trump's bootlicking is an embarrassment to our country. https://t.co/1WURXkvGIC

With so much grift in the Trump admin it's hard to keep track of who is selling pardons, who is selling access, and who is buying it all.
 
When the wealthy can buy their own laws & subvert justice it reveals a completely corrupt and rigged system. https://t.co/kxszPzOxLl

Today, while protecting Palestinians, Brad Lander & a group of American rabbis & others were taken by the IDF. Releasing Brad isn't enough, the Israeli govt must release them all.
 
If this is how they treat Americans, imagine how they treat Palestinians. Trump & Rubio's silence fuels this impunity.

When push comes to shove, Trump would rather you lose power than the data center companies lose a cent of profit. Clearly, this admin & FERC are not protecting consumers. 
 
Congress must pass my Power for the People Act, to ensure that your power needs are put before Big Tech's.

https://t.co/1YeLN50xxy

Eight days ago, less than a month before an election, Trump's DOJ raided @Ilhan's home in what we know is a fascistic attempt to denaturalize & deport her.
 
We cannot become numb to these blatant abuses of power. Failure to call this for what it is, is complicity.

https://t.co/9R99qphM7Y

Meanwhile, SpaceX CEO, Elon Musk, has spent over $360 MILLION in our elections this cycle.

This should be illegal — but it isn't. I'll be introducing a bill to close the loophole that allows it. https://t.co/BVoDLDokew

Another day, another wildly corrupt plot that would shock the country under any other administration.
 
Trump & his rich friends have turned the federal govt into a pay-to-play scheme — exchanging millions of dollars for favors & selling access to foreign tycoons.

https://t.co/NpTgmrSdRZ

Trump wants to spend hundreds of thousands of your tax dollars on an ad campaign to attract more White South African "refugees."
 
This white nationalist immigration policy is a waste of taxpayer dollars & it makes a mockery of our laws & Lady Liberty's promise. It must end.

https://t.co/u3Mu0WysbN

Trump kicked millions off their healthcare & caused back-to-back double-digit spikes in ACA premiums — all to fund tax breaks for billionaires.
 
Your healthcare shouldn't be at the whim of Republicans, corporate middlemen, or the billionaire class. We need Medicare for All. https://t.co/rI9N1qninp

They started the Iran war together. They crack down on press freedom together. They lie about everything together. 

Authoritarians of a feather flock together. https://t.co/xkXxCU4shO

Trump started an illegal war, prices are through the roof, Americans are hurting, & yet he lays awake thinking about how to screw our DC neighbors & take over their public parks.

Out of touch doesn’t even begin to describe it. https://t.co/hQFf19EDwm

Unacceptable. Meta took down the No Kings Instagram today and kept it offline for well over an hour.

Censoring free speech to appease Donald Trump?

We the people deserve answers, but regardless, we will not be silenced.

Hate against our South-Asian communities is on the rise, last Sunday’s planned attack was an example of this horrifying truth.
 
I am grateful that worshipers at the Balaji Temple in Illinois weren’t harmed. Everyone, regardless of party, must call out & condemn this hatred.

243 years ago, George Washington resigned his commission & made one thing clear: We will have no kings in America. Today, we have a president who's ripping up our Constitution & trampling over our democracy.

We must show him that he won't get away with it.

NO KINGS! https://t.co/k1Tv6FKVee

Today, another American citizen & journalist was brutalized by Israeli settlers attacking Palestinians in the West Bank.

This repeated violence & brazen impunity for attacks against Americans & Palestinians alike are unacceptable.

When will Trump & Rubio DO SOMETHING?

Erdogan has now taken over 5 major news outlets in Turkey.

Meanwhile, what is the supposed leader of the free world doing? Going after political opponents & banning media outlets from covering him.

Trump's crackdowns only embolden authoritarians the world over.

This is heartbreaking. From this senseless act in Bend to the daily toll of violence on our communities, we must do better for our children.
 
We need to pass gun safety laws now. Anyone who stands in the way is complicit.

https://t.co/PZoh5dCrBZ https://t.co/NwId3MWzke

New @washingtonpost reporting shows a majority of the money Trump has "raised" for his ballroom has come from companies or wealthy people with interests before the federal govt.
 
Make no mistake this is a two-way street: every single one of these donors wants something in https://t.co/HwRj0GAe3O

Hegseth eliminated staff who prevent civilian casualties, called the rules of engagement safeguarding civilians 'stupid,' & now he's covering up the report on the Minab school strike that killed over 120 children.
 
He needs to be removed from office & we need accountability NOW. https://t.co/yNmWkuk6XU

This is the result of 7+ years of Trump's attacks on @Ilhan, Somali-Americans, & the Muslim community.
 
Everyone, regardless of party, must speak out against this fascistic abuse of power.
 
If they can do this to a sitting Congresswoman, they can & will do it to anyone. https://t.co/JAaBjz2VEn

Americans can feel it, now the numbers confirm it: Inflation is only getting worse.
 
End the war, protect our troops, lower costs — it's that simple. The fact that Trump refuses to do so — while he uses the Oval Office to make money for himself — is shameful.

Some good news: our efforts to clean up the Chesapeake Bay are paying off! The Bay is a national treasure & an economic & environmental lifeline to our state & region.
 
We can't stop now.
 
There's more to do, & we won't let Trump, big polluters, or anyone else stop this https://t.co/MbVaOdrnzU

🚨 A federal judge has halted Trump's attempts to close the Beltsville Agricultural Research Center in MD.
 
For decades, experts at BARC have protected our food & farmers, including from threats like cyclospora.
 
We'll keep working to protect BARC & these dedicated civil

Musk's DOGE boys took a 'sledgehammer' to the federal govt & services people relied on. Now they're getting rich off the pain they caused.
 
DOGE was never about efficiency, it was about breaking the govt & selling it off to Trump's billionaire buddies & allies.
 
Endless grift. https://t.co/aNN8ws5kAp

Never in recorded history have corporations made more than they do today.
 
Never in recorded history have workers taken home less of those profits than they do today.
 
That's Trump's economy in a nutshell.

https://t.co/1hVjvmQym9 https://t.co/0OOLBIMV57

Despite a court order, Trump kept using your tax dollars to run his propaganda ads.
 
From his gold-plated ballroom, to his new DC golf course, to these illegal ads, Trump will use your tax dollars to do everything but lower your costs.
 
He & his minions must reimburse https://t.co/y8d9PBGhXw

Did you know businesses with federal govt contracts aren’t allowed to spend for or against federal candidates? 

How then has Elon Musk, whose companies get billions in contracts, spent hundreds of millions in our elections?

The answer: A giant loophole I'm working to close. https://t.co/aLwCIcDOWV

Trump’s destruction of parts of a DC public park in violation of a federal judge’s order cannot go unpunished. 

This land, like the Kennedy Center & Yosemite belongs to the people, not him. 

The perpetrators need to be held in contempt. https://t.co/MgACdoOSm6

Trump's continued attacks on @Ilhan, the Somali American community, & our Muslim neighbors are a heinous attempt to distract from his complete & utter failure as president. Every American should be chilled to the bone: these are the actions of a dictatorship not a democracy. https://t.co/irtQtacbiL

As Trump himself said, this entire campaign is about protecting Netanyahu.
 
Words of condemnation aren't enough, ICC members must take action to defend the rule of law. Remember, ICC prosecutors have the authority to open criminal investigations against ANYONE who obstructs https://t.co/Ofb3VdhW5K

26 years ago, we eradicated measles. Now, this year alone, there have been over 4,000 cases, 40+ outbreaks, and people have died.

RFK Jr.'s anti-vax rhetoric & conspiracy theories have consequences. He must resign NOW. Vaccines are safe & effective. Period.

Trump started a stupid & illegal war in Iran that has driven up diesel prices. Now he wants to bankroll Putin's illegal war against Ukraine by buying diesel from him.
 
One strategic disaster after the next.

https://t.co/S9tqfdLDUj https://t.co/GvJbV0sgA6

Trump is STILL using your tax dollars to pay for this propaganda — even after promising to pay for these ads himself.
 
Every single dollar spent on this BS campaign is a dollar that could be going toward lowering your costs. It must end, NOW. https://t.co/IGaUgZwdg4

New @nytimes reporting shows US Embassy officials in Israel are blocking info from Congress on the killings of Americans in the West Bank.

I'm calling on @SenatorRisch & the Foreign Relations Committee to hold a hearing into this coverup.

The American people deserve the truth. https://t.co/9uvlbc098w

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
